name: search_hotels
description: Search family-friendly hotels in Japan by verified kid-friendly conditions, area, child age, price or hotel name. Each result includes the hotel's page URL.

arguments.name: keyword
arguments.desc: Hotel name (partial match; Japanese or English name, or slug)

arguments.name: conditions
arguments.desc: Condition IDs to require (AND). See list_conditions.

arguments.name: child_age
arguments.desc: Child's age in years; filters hotels whose target age range matches

arguments.name: max_price
arguments.desc: Maximum price per person per night in JPY (approximate)

name: get_hotel
description: Get one hotel's full details: all verified conditions with per-hotel evidence notes, kids' facilities, access, sources and verification date.

name: list_conditions
description: List all kid-friendly conditions usable in search (id, label, target age, number of matching hotels).

name: list_areas
description: List hotel counts by prefecture, major areas and curated area guide pages, to narrow a search.
